newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex says '96 cement sales 9.61 mln tons.
newsitem.headline: Cemex says '96 cement sales 9.61 mln tons.

text.p: Grupo Cemex plans to sell 9.61 million tonnes of cement this year, or 4.45 percent more than 1995, a company official said.
"We expect around 30 percent to go to the Asian market, compared with 20 percent in 1995," said Cemex marketing head Javier Prieto at a news conference.
Cemex' operations mainly consist of exporting cement and clinker from plants in several countries, as well as selling cement produced in third countries.
Prieto estimated that Cemex's Mexican division will export 4.0 million tonnes in 1996, with Spain exporting 2.1 million tonnes and Venezuela another 2.2 million tonnes.

"We forecast doubling cement exports to the Phillipines to reach 500,000 tonnes in 1996. In addition to Indonesia, Phillipines and Malaysia, our new customers include Chile, Egypt and Kuwait," Prieto added.
Cemex is the world's third biggest cement producer, with an overall installed capacity close to 50 million tons a year.
